news.title: Meta Platforms Stock Jumps 7% Today as Bloomberg Reports Company Plans to Enter the Cloud Business
news.description: Meta Platforms plans to sell its AI computing capacity, entering the cloud market and competing with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. This strategic shift aims to monetize its data center investments.
